item.description:
Mass shootings are rare in Poland. The country has been on alert since October, when it saw a series of school attacks and stabbings that Tusk called a "cult of violence," AFP reported. Gun licences are rising quickly. More than 50,000 were issued in 2025, bringing the total to 411,000. Authorities have not yet said whether the suspect's weapons were legal.

item.title: Trump offers UFC chief Dana White press secretary job
item.description: Trump and White have known each other since 2001, when Trump hosted UFC 30 at the Trump Taj Mahal in Atlantic City. In May, the UFC held fights on the White House South Lawn as part of the Freedom 250 celebration. White most recently introduced Trump at a midterm campaign rally in Las Vegas in August. He has long said he has no interest in politics.

item.title: US measles cases top 5,000, most since 1991, CDC says
item.description: The U.S. eliminated measles in 2000. It could now lose that status, which requires going at least 12 months without continuous spread of the disease. Canada lost its status in November 2025, USA Today noted. Utah and South Carolina are each dealing with outbreaks of 500 or more cases, and New York declared a state of emergency on Oct. 5. item.title: US adds 165,000 jobs in October; jobless rate dips to 4.1%
item.description:
Even after the October gain, hiring is modest by historical standards. Before this report, employers had added an average of 68,000 jobs a month in 2026. That beats 2025's average of 9,700 but is far below the 166,000 a month seen in 2023 and 2024, the AP reported. Economists call it a "low-fire, low-hire" market.
Retirements and tighter immigration also mean fewer people are looking for work....
